cells.gaps: No source counts the councils connected against the 35: the 2024 minutes name Kasungu on the Boma network and Dowa as not yet connected (MWI-007), and the only count is the four city councils' own office internet in 2022 (MWI-017, count:4 of 35), which says nothing of the other 31. The newest authorities fact, pilot (MWI-003, 2026-06), is a two-district test of registry updating and not a measure of the connection. The systems facts of 2026 (MWI-001, MWI-002) do not say over what connection councils work; on the government network the stated use is internet (MWI-006), slow and unreliable, with government email still awaited. MWI-020 (2022-09) reads none for the IFMIS network and is older than MWI-005.
cells.note: The internet the Digital Malawi Project provided to the councils is in use on the government network at councils outside the capital, managed by the Department of E-Government, so the connection is institutional and past its pilot. Stage 4 needs more than half on a share or a count with its total, and no source gives one.
